headline: Anti-election-commission protests grip Delhi while the rupee rebounds on RBI action, a Broadcom warning sparks a global AI selloff, and Meta unveils its Muse Wonder models.

stories.title: Anti-CEC protests: Supreme Court defers hearing to October 15
stories.summary: The Supreme Court deferred hearing pleas on the Delhi protests and curbs on metro and trains to October 15. Delhi Police has sought to extend the deployment of 273 CAPF companies in the capital till October 20.
stories.why_it_matters: The protests over revised electoral rolls are a major national political and legal story.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay to meet Naidu on Krishna water for Chennai
stories.summary: Under the 1983 Telugu Ganga agreement, 15 TMC is to be delivered annually at the Tamil Nadu border. Low storage in Srisailam, Somasila and Kandaleru makes a partial release the likely compromise, sources say.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an inter-state water issue involving Andhra Pradesh reservoirs and the AP CM.

stories.title: Protest leaders detained after crossing barricades in central Delhi
stories.summary: Protesters climbed over barricades in central Delhi to demand that the election chief resign over revised voter lists. Some leaders were detained. Bengaluru police also detained over 100 people trying to march against the SIR of electoral rolls.
stories.why_it_matters: The SIR dispute is spreading across states and raising the political temperature.

stories.title: Collector orders GMR to repair roads damaged by Bhogapuram airport construction
stories.summary: After a Hindu report, the Vizianagaram Collector ordered GMR to repair the damaged roads and asked NHAI to connect the airport to the highway service roads. NHAI says the changes will be made in a couple of weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: Bhogapuram airport is a flagship Andhra project and the fix affects locals cut off by construction.

stories.title: Hyderabad office leasing up 50% in nine months of 2026
stories.summary: Knight Frank says leasing crossed 13.1 million sq ft. GCCs accounted for 47% of transactions and flexible workspace for 26%.
stories.why_it_matters: GCC demand signals a strong tech hiring market in Hyderabad.

stories.title: Low pressure over Bay of Bengal may bring rain to Andhra Pradesh from October 15
stories.summary: IMD says all three regions of the state may get moderate showers from October 15 to 19.
stories.why_it_matters: A regional weather heads-up for Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: 2,200 personnel to secure India-West Indies T20 at Uppal on October 14
stories.summary: About 40,000 spectators are expected for the 7 p.m. match. Police have identified parking for 8,000 vehicles and announced heavy-vehicle diversions around the stadium.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful if you are in Hyderabad on match day.

stories.title: Former security guard arrested for murder of five-year-old in Kowkoor over ransom
stories.summary: The accused demanded ₹20 lakh ransom for the girl. Residents of the gated community raised concerns about children's safety.
stories.why_it_matters: A major crime story in Hyderabad.

stories.title: Around 100 YSRCP workers join TDP in Visakhapatnam ahead of local body polls
stories.summary: Leaders and workers from GVMC Ward 6 joined the TDP. YSRCP is separately planning a digital outreach for the local body polls.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows early local-body-poll positioning in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: Trump insists energy ceasefire holds as Russia strikes continue
stories.summary: Trump says Putin and Zelenskyy agreed to stop attacks on energy sites. Ukraine says six energy sites have been hit since the announcement.
stories.why_it_matters: The ceasefire looks shaky, with implications for the war and energy prices.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia vows 'serious response' after Houthi attacks on airports
stories.summary: The Houthis hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major Gulf escalation with regional and oil implications.

stories.title: What the US-Russia diesel deal means for India
stories.summary: The deal lets Russia sell diesel to the US and global markets, alongside Trump's announced energy ceasefire.
stories.why_it_matters: Fuel supply and pricing affect India's import bill and inflation.

stories.title: IMF: Middle East and Central Asia economy to shrink in 2026
stories.summary: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit GDP declines after the US-Israel war on Iran.
stories.why_it_matters: The Gulf is key for Indian remittances and oil.

stories.title: PTI braces to fight federal takeover of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
stories.summary: Islamabad says PTI failed to lead the fight against armed groups. Analysts question the takeover.
stories.why_it_matters: Political instability in Pakistan matters for the region.

stories.title: Trump hedges on Netanyahu ahead of October 27 Israeli election
stories.summary: The US president has not endorsed Netanyahu amid shifting public sentiment.
stories.why_it_matters: The election outcome could shift Middle East policy.

stories.title: Rupee jumps 177 paise in two days to 94.06 after RBI intervention
stories.summary: RBI offered a special dollar window for oil firms and tightened forex derivative rules to defend the ₹97 level. Macro risks and FII outflows remain.
stories.why_it_matters: A weak rupee feeds into inflation, imports and the returns of your investments.

stories.title: Global AI selloff hits Kospi; Indian IT stocks rally
stories.summary: Kospi plunged 7.4% on chip competition concerns and Broadcom's warning on AI spending. Indian IT stocks added ₹26,000 crore in market cap as investors rotated into services.
stories.why_it_matters: It directly affects the IT-services sector that employs many engineers and moves index funds.

stories.title: Broadcom CEO says investors treat AI like gambling
stories.summary: Hock Tan's warning raised concerns about excessive valuations and OpenAI's long-term profitability.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the trigger for the AI-stock selloff and a read on AI funding sustainability.

stories.title: Nifty 50 Q2 earnings may surge but road ahead is rocky
stories.summary: Metals, banks and consumer companies are expected to lead profit growth. A delayed crude shock and limited pricing power could put FY27 estimates at risk.
stories.why_it_matters: It frames the earnings season for index-fund investors.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission latest developments
stories.summary: The commission, chaired by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, is reviewing pay and pension changes, with its report due by May 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a significant policy development in government pay.

stories.title: Six IPOs open between October 13 and 15
stories.summary: Zetwerk, HD Fire Protect, Fusion CX, Bonfiglioli Transmissions and Tonbo Imaging are among the six issues opening in the window.
stories.why_it_matters: A heavy primary-market week to track.

stories.title: Jio Platforms' proposed ₹30,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: Reliance could see a valuation re-rating as Jio's proposed ₹30,000 crore IPO brings greater transparency to its digital business.
stories.why_it_matters: It would be among India's largest listings.

stories.title: Meta releases frontier models Muse Wonder and Wonder Full
stories.summary: Meta unveiled two larger models that it says perform comparably to OpenAI's and Anthropic's, citing benchmarks from Artificial Analysis. They have higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.
stories.why_it_matters: A new frontier competitor affects the model choices engineers build on.

stories.title: Anthropic says small AI models may soon self-replicate on home devices
stories.summary: Anthropic says small models could become capable of self-replication without a data centre within months.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a notable AI safety claim from a leading lab.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 AI chip
stories.summary: The third-generation in-house chip is designed as the primary AI inference system for Microsoft's products and handles reasoning and agentic tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: It reduces reliance on Nvidia and changes AI infrastructure economics.

stories.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, sells some assets to Disney for $20M
stories.summary: The company filed Chapter 11 and intends to keep operating while completing the sale.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals consumer-AI shakeout risk.

stories.title: Sarvam in talks for round that could double valuation to $3B
stories.summary: The Indian AI firm is reportedly raising a big round. HCLTech's Q2 profit also rose.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a signal for India's AI-startup hiring and funding.

stories.title: Anthropic says new safeguards reduce distillation attacks
stories.summary: New measures to stop rivals copying Claude's capabilities have reduced data harvested in distillation attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to model security and competitive dynamics.

stories.title: NTT Data in talks to build Anthropic's first Japan data centre
stories.summary: Nikkei reports final talks for a data centre in Osaka.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows Anthropic's infrastructure expansion.

stories.title: Nvidia's China AI-chip share falls to 34%
stories.summary: IDC says export controls and Huawei's gains cut Nvidia's share in H1 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: It reflects shifting global AI hardware competition.

stories.title: Spotify more than doubled monthly code changes with AI
stories.summary: Spotify reports AI-assisted development more than doubled merged changes. It is changing testing, observability, rollback and prioritization to cope.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a practical look at engineering practice at AI-driven scale.

stories.title: Codex CLI installs a persistent self-updating background daemon by default
stories.summary: A GitHub issue on OpenAI's Codex CLI drew 542 points and 272 comments on Hacker News over the default daemon.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a relevant security and trust question for AI coding tools.

stories.title: GitLab 19.4 adds goal-driven agents and AI cost controls
stories.summary: The release adds a goal-driven mode in Duo CLI, more MCP tools, hosted open-weight models and finer AI spend controls.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows where agent tooling is heading.

stories.title: You can't trust your AI bill
stories.summary: A talk argues AI spend is eclipsing cloud bills and covers tokenmaxxing and unit economics.
stories.why_it_matters: AI cost management is becoming an engineering skill.

stories.title: Epic Games pivots to AI-first development
stories.summary: CEO Tim Sweeney called it a 'huge pivot', six months after Epic announced over 1,000 layoffs, which it attributed to slower growth. Ars reports it as 'no more hand-written code'.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a signal of how AI is reshaping developer roles.

stories.title: RDI Fund names first cohort of 19 fund managers to deploy ₹7,131 crore
stories.summary: The cohort includes 14 AIFs and five research organisations backing deeptech startups.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a funding tailwind for Indian deeptech.

stories.title: Fintech funding up 14% to $2.2B in Jan-Sep, deal count down 41%
stories.summary: Tracxn says rounds fell to 153 from 260.
stories.why_it_matters: It reflects the fintech hiring and funding climate.

stories.title: Amazon has over 1 million robot workers
stories.summary: The second-largest corporate employer has bet heavily on robots to scale.
stories.why_it_matters: It points to automation's effect on jobs.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant out of first two four-dayers against New Zealand A
stories.summary: Pant has a left side strain and is replaced by Kumar Kushagra in the India A squad.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects India's wicketkeeping plans.

stories.title: Australia six wickets away after Renshaw's 190 and 82
stories.summary: Renshaw followed his first-innings 190 with 82 off 99 balls and a wicket.
stories.why_it_matters: A dominant performance in a live Test.

stories.title: Sri Lanka look to avoid whitewash against Pakistan
stories.summary: Pakistan have the series won. Sri Lanka's Test squad sees Nissanka return.
stories.why_it_matters: Part of the ongoing international calendar.

stories.title: Fireship: Every app on Earth is now open source
stories.summary: A developer rewrote seven Adobe apps in Rust and open-sourced them; the video tests them out.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a quick view of AI-assisted rewrites and open source.
